// The pre-fix shape of cmd/nova-work/firstrun_test.go, kept as a fixture so the
// scanner is exercised on the text the class rule is about. `dependencies`
// WRITES the file named by --graph, so a run of this test leaves a deps.json in
// the package directory -- the class #1311 closed for scratch/, met again.
package fixture

import "testing"

func TestFirstRunExampleRuns(t *testing.T) {
	if code, _, stderr := runCLI(t, "dependencies", "--graph", "./deps.json", "--node", "b"); code != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("the usage example does not run: exit %d, stderr: %s", code, stderr)
	}
}

func TestPacketIsWrittenWhereItIsAsked(t *testing.T) {
	var out, errb bytes.Buffer
	if code := run([]string{"packet", "--who", "emma", "--out", "packet.md"}, &out, &errb); code != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("packet exit=%d stderr=%s", code, errb.String())
	}
}
